urlText: Sydney CBD bus diversions for Sydney Marathon
content:
On Sunday 31 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads including the Harbour Bridge are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  
From 3am to 11am, route 120 buses will run to and from Crows Nest only. Buses will not run to and from the city.  
 
Buses towards the city will end trips at Crows Nest Station, Pacific Hwy Crows Nest (206515). Buses towards Chatswood will start trips from Crows Nest Station, Pacific Hwy Crows Nest (206515).  
 
Stops on York St and Clarence St will be missed.  
 
Change for metro services to continue your trip between Crows Nest and the city. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.
